All JSON fixtures are synthetic, hand-authored from sibling nav_web.py state_json and health_web.py build/tile source. Each carries _synthetic:true and _source provenance. Arrays and ancillary controller fields use synthetic empty/default values; health_ok is a readiness-focused tile subset, not a whole deployment inventory. They are not evidence of live hardware behavior.

navweb_state_idle.json: nav stack running, navigation idle, no e-stop.
navweb_state_navigating.json: active navigation with distance and goal.
navweb_state_estop.json: navigation canceled with soft e-stop latched.
health_nobase.json: synthetic base_rpc down tile.
health_ok.json: base_rpc tile state=ok,value=up, as generated by health_web.py:1580.

map_small.bin is regenerated deterministically by test_source_layout_round_trip_and_generated_fixture in test_mapcheck.py. It is gzip-compressed synthetic20x20 occupancy data: row0 unknown255, column10 occupied100, remaining cells free0. Header is <7f>: version7,width20,height20,resolution0.1,origin_x-1,origin_y-1,origin_yaw0, matching nav_web.py:1526-1538. No hardware capture was attempted. Replace synthetic captures only during the separately authorized attended hardware task.
